justification: Changes how the DCP monitor waits when a council site rate-limits it; what counts as checked is unchanged.

pre_impl.existing_data: dcp_monitor_chapter_results run_id=2: 36 rate_limited rows, all www.innerwest.nsw.gov.au (marrickville 26, leichhardt 7, ashfield 3).
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: The old code assumed one backoff of up to 60 s clears a 429; run 2 shows the site blocks for minutes after ~15 requests, again and again.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: One new helper replaces the inline single retry; adaptive delay and recording are reused unchanged.

falsifiable_check.fails_when: a block longer than 60 s is not recovered, a blocked host is paused past the budget, or a non-429 answer is retried
falsifiable_check.observed_red: 8 hand mutants all killed; two survived the first test draft (budget-spent still sent requests; a 403 was retried) and the tests were tightened.

functions.name: retry_rate_limited
functions.input: a chapter URL that just answered HTTP 429, plus injectable head and sleep
functions.output: the last HEAD answer after pausing the host 60, 120 then 300 s
functions.if_none: budget spent for the host returns status 429 at once with no request

break_it.scenario: A site blocks for 3 minutes after every 15 requests (Inner West, run 2)
break_it.what_happens: silent loss: old code skipped 5-7 chapters per block as rate_limited
break_it.how: escalating host pauses retry the same chapter until the block lifts

break_it.scenario: A site blocks for the whole run
break_it.what_happens: without a cap the run would sleep 8 minutes per chapter for hours
break_it.how: 30 minute budget per host per run, then skip with no further requests

break_it.scenario: After a pause the site answers 403 instead of 429
break_it.what_happens: a 403 retried as if rate-limited would waste the budget
break_it.how: any non-429 answer is returned at once to the caller

post_merge.db_reset: None: no schema or data change.
post_merge.manual_verify: Next force run on Railway: Inner West rate_limited count in dcp_monitor_chapter_results falls from 36, and the run still finishes.
